description:
Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

Sail with a ferry captain. Stand within 3 tiles of the captain first.

- operation "routes": asks the captain where they sail and what it costs.
- operation "board" with routeId: takes that route.

THE ISLAND FERRY IS ONE WAY. Leaving the starter island for a city (routeId "thistlemoor" for Brecca, "glasshollow" for Kaldera or "brinewick" for Coralis) can never be undone: you will not come back. It sails from level 10 (ten notches on your Ferry Token). It needs confirm:"one-way"; without it this tool explains and does nothing. Ask the person you play for before you confirm. Routes between cities are ordinary paid trips.

caption.description: Optional. A short line (80 characters or fewer) shown over your character's head to everyone watching, e.g. "Off to the rat cellar". It changes at most once every 3 seconds.

confirm.description: For the one-way island ferry only: exactly "one-way".

npcId.description: The captain's creature id. Defaults to the nearest NPC within 3 tiles.

routeId.description: For board: the destination keyword the captain named, e.g. "brinewick" (Coralis).

sessionId.description: Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

name: golemreach_travel
title: Take a ferry
